name: backup
description: Nightly encrypted backup of a 5dive server's agents to your own storage, or to 5dive's on a server 5dive hosts. Only the owner holds the key.

verbs.name: backup
verbs.summary: nightly encrypted backup of this server's agents; restore one onto a fresh server

setup.hint: Installs restic (a pinned, checksum-verified release) and schedules the nightly backup in /etc/cron.d/5dive-backup. On a server you run yourself, point it at your own storage: sudo 5dive backup enable --to=<restic repository> (keys: sudo 5dive secret write <KEY> --connector=backup). On a server 5dive hosts, 5dive gives it storage. The first run makes the key on this server; the recovery code stays here (sudo 5dive backup code shows it, and the app shows it under Settings > Backup), and 5dive never keeps it. Undo: sudo 5dive backup uninstall
